title: Urania designs new gravitational-wave detectors
summary: The April 2025 Physical Review X article describes Urania, a computational search for gravitational-wave interferometer topologies. Its simulated solutions increase potentially observable volume by up to 50-fold under the study constraints; 50 designs are shared in a detector zoo. These are proposed designs rather than constructed detectors. The work first appeared as an arXiv preprint in December 2023.
organization: Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light; California Institute of Technology

evidence.tested: Simulated performance checks of newly designed interferometer topologies under experimental constraints.
evidence.unknown: Not assessed: detailed noise and hardware feasibility assumptions in the full article.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning-inspired continuous optimization searched detector configurations.
